name: Nox Sidereal IV

perks.name: Arrowhead Brake
perks.desc:
Lightly vented barrel.
  •  Greatly controls recoil
  •  Increases handling speed

perks.name: Chambered Compensator
perks.desc:
Stable barrel attachment.
  •  Increases stability
  •  Moderately controls recoil
  •  Slightly decreases handling speed

perks.name: Corkscrew Rifling
perks.desc:
Balanced barrel. 
  •  Slightly increases range and stability
  •  Slightly increases handling speed

perks.name: Extended Barrel
perks.desc:
Weighty barrel extension.
  •  Increases range
  •  Decreases handling speed
  •  Moderately controls recoil

perks.name: Fluted Barrel
perks.desc:
Ultra-light barrel. 
  •  Greatly increases handling speed
  •  Slightly increases stability

perks.name: Full Bore
perks.desc:
Barrel optimized for distance.
  •  Greatly increases range
  •  Decreases stability
  •  Slightly decreases handling speed

perks.name: Hammer-Forged Rifling
perks.desc:
Durable ranged barrel.
  •  Increases range

perks.name: Polygonal Rifling
perks.desc:
Barrel optimized for recoil reduction.
  •  Increases stability

perks.name: Smallbore
perks.desc:
Dual strength barrel.
  •  Increases range
  •  Increases stability

perks.name: Full Choke
perks.desc: Tightened barrel. Reduces projectile spread when aiming down sights at the cost of precision damage.

perks.name: Rifled Barrel
perks.desc:
Ranged shotgun barrel.
  •  Increases range
  •  Greatly decreases handling speed

perks.name: Accelerated Coils
perks.desc:
Speeds up charge.
  •  Faster charge time
  •  Decreases impact damage

perks.name: Enhanced Battery
perks.desc:
Strong battery life.
  •  Increases magazine size

perks.name: Ionized Battery
perks.desc:
Large heavy battery.
  •  Greatly increases magazine size
  •  Greatly decreases reload speed

perks.name: Liquid Coils
perks.desc:
Slower-building charge for higher damage.
  •  Increases impact damage
  •  Slower charge time

perks.name: Particle Repeater
perks.desc:
Improves stability. 
  •  Increases stability

perks.name: Projection Fuse
perks.desc:
Distance optimizations.
  •  Increases range

perks.name: Clown Cartridge
perks.desc: Reloading this weapon randomly overfills it from reserves.

perks.name: Ambitious Assassin
perks.desc: Overflows the magazine based on the number of rapid kills before reloading.

perks.name: Proximity Power
perks.desc: When targets are nearby, final blows grant bonus Melee stat.

perks.name: Shot Swap
perks.desc: Final blows build and store charges which allow you to swap and stow this weapon at a faster rate.

perks.name: Stats for All
perks.desc: Hitting three separate targets increases weapon handling, stability, reload, and range for a moderate duration.

perks.name: Demolitionist
perks.desc: Kills with this weapon generate grenade energy. Activating your grenade ability reloads this weapon from reserves.

perks.name: Frenzy
perks.desc: Being in combat for an extended time increases damage, handling, and reload for this weapon until you are out of combat.

perks.name: Crystalline Corpsebloom
perks.desc: Rapid final blows spawn a [Stasis] Stasis crystal near the victim's location.

perks.name: Master of Arms
perks.desc: Kills with any weapon improve this weapon's damage for a short time.

perks.name: Discord
perks.desc: Final blows with another weapon grant this weapon increased speed for aiming down sights, accuracy, and airborne effectiveness for a short time. When Discord is active, final blows refund ammo.

perks.name: Reservoir Burst
perks.desc: When the battery is full, your next burst deals additional damage and causes enemies to explode on death.

perks.name: Adrenaline Junkie
perks.desc: This weapon gains increased damage and handling from final blows with grenades or this weapon.

perks.name: Accelerated Assault
perks.desc: Dealing sustained damage with this weapon loads a small amount of ammo from reserves, or removes heat, and slightly increases damage.

perks.name: Vanguard Determination
perks.desc: After using your class ability, final blows with this weapon grant you bonus damage resistance.

perks.name: Wild Card
perks.desc: Final blows with this weapon have a chance to create experimental submunitions at the target's location.

notes: Inspired by @Saint_Kabr, @CourtProjects and @ImpetusAlways (PvE PvE-Minor PvE-GroupAdd PvE-EndGame PvE-God M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE roll for clearing groups of Minor adds in both general at-level or better, and end-game underleveled content. Nox Sidereal IV is an aggressive fusion rifle, which are rated B-Tier for endgame PvE by @TheAegisRelic tiering spreadsheet https://linktr.ee/TheAegisRelic offering best one-mag boss DPS post-buff 9.5.0 in December 2025, although still a bit awkward to use on some bosses. The frame intrinsic fires three bursts of four bolts each in an increasingly wider spread as per the https://www.destiny2.science/ Destiny Data Compendium. The stats are poor by comparison with its peers - hopefully when the website's back https://d2foundry.gg/w/2875763009 will show how the weapon stats impact in-game performance. First priority with the barrel perk is recoil control, and then with the magazine perk look for something that helps improve battery capacity or speeds up Charge Time. For add group clearing, use Clown Cartridge or Ambitious Assassin to overflow the battery to use with Reservoir Burst, which boosts battery capacity and provides a ×1.25 (×1.275 when enhanced) damage boost when the battery is at or above maximum capacity, triggering a ~1-2m AoE explosion on a kill. If you can get close enough to reliably land shots, with the high one-mag damage this could also be a good burst damage weapon against orange and yellow-bar enemies. The Wild Card origin trait provides the chance of Telesto-like "Experimental Submunitions" dropping on a kill - the number depends on the enemy tier - that last up to 10.5s and explode on contact or proximity to an enemy. Of less interest is Vanguard Vindication which provides up to ×3 stacks that reduces incoming damage at max to ×0.94 for a refreshable 10s (12.5s when enhanced), on kills within 20s of using a class ability. If you're interested, "Nox Sidereal" is a compound phrase derived from Latin, meaning "night of the stars". Recommended MW: Charge Time, with an enhanced Charge Time mod or with your preferred choice of mod to boost weapon stats, ammo generation, or elemental pickups for builds - and don't forget to check any available seasonal fragile mods.
